decisions.summary: Audit read-only over a copy of the record taken from 269's clone (main plus 269's unlanded research); every section classed; judgment on Opus
decisions.why: FR-001's coverage; reading the newest text widens, not narrows, what is swept.

decisions.summary: Research in page sessions from generated briefs, four-question cap, reserved prefixes, three outcomes incl. undated-custom
decisions.why: Restates FR-003, FR-004 and spec D1.

decisions.summary: One serial queue; groups on sections 269 rewrote run after the others, behind wait269.sh (research-on-main as the proxy for 269 landing); 279's R5 last
decisions.why: Ordering only; spec Edge Cases hold 269's sections until it lands, and 269 cannot push its record before its tasks close, so the proxy is sound.

decisions.summary: wait269.sh gives up after 10 hours and the queue goes on; the brief's claims step then skips any item whose section is held, and nothing re-queues it
decisions.why: A timeout is not impossibility. A skipped item leaves with no outcome, against FR-003 (every candidate researched) and SC-002 (every candidate has an outcome line): up to 14 groups, M09-M63, M74-M77, M93-M95, M128-M130, could silently drop. The backstop also fails its own purpose: the brief skips sections 'claimed since' / 'in progress', and 269's claim lines read 'done, committed in clone', so after a timeout a session can edit 269's unlanded sections (FR-010).

decisions.summary: R5 (M78-M81, religion-and-death 124-127) runs only once 279 marks done; otherwise the claims step skips it and names it in the handoff
decisions.why: The spec already routes a held section: research it, write the finding in the handoff, send it to the owner (Edge Cases, FR-002). Skipping instead leaves M78-M81 with no outcome - two are strength S (the drawn precinct band is, by the record's own words, Meiji-or-later) and the engine kinds (ShrineGrove, ShrineBasin) are not 279's (279's claim: engine none). Also the mechanism cannot do what D3 says even when 279 is done: gen.py's HEAD forbids editing religion-and-death 124-129 unconditionally in every brief, including R5's, whose step 5 tells it to write on 124-127.

decisions.summary: Eliminations only after research and from outcomes.md; nothing touches a 269 module before 269 lands; per-form removal, retirement or prose narrowing, regeneration, review, make done; MIXED keeps attested forms and calibrates degrees
decisions.why: Spec phase 3, FR-005, FR-010, acceptance scenario 3.

decisions.summary: Unknowingly ruled-in forms eliminated and reported; knowingly ruled-in forms to the GM via escalation-check before removal
decisions.why: FR-006 verbatim; the exception was ruled on at spec round 2.

decisions.summary: Legacy maps not edited; each modern-only form recorded in migration-plan.md owed at conversion; list to the GM via escalation-check
decisions.why: Spec D2, FR-007, SC-004; judged legitimate at spec round 1 and the plan adds nothing to it.

decisions.summary: Findings owed to another feature's section go in the handoff to the owner
Stray fixes found by the audit made in place when outside every held module and section; else listed with owner
